workflow_stage_1_desc: photograph the pack, front and back
workflow_stage_2_desc: OCR on CPU, text with its position on the image
workflow_stage_3_desc: MRP, net quantity, dates, addresses, pulled out of the text
workflow_stage_4_desc: the catalogue runs, exempt rules are marked not applicable
workflow_stage_5_desc: every finding points at the box on the image it came from
workflow_stage_6_desc: the officer confirms anything the system marks for review
workflow_stage_7_desc: PDF with the image hash, a verification QR and an audit entry
tol_declared_hint: Enter the declared quantity if the label was not read
tol_footnote: Rule 22 and the First Schedule maximum permissible error (MPE), Rules 19–21 with the Fifth–Seventh Schedules (lot sampling, tare, corrected average, Form A/B). Readings are entered by the officer; the verdict is a review aid, not a legal determination.
geometry_mode_hint: Needs the pack width in millimetres. Results are for your confirmation with a scale.
maap_estimated: Estimated from the photo — confirm with a scale
listing_subtitle: Rule 6(10) declarations and Rule 31 font parity on a marketplace listing
listing_screenshots_hint: A screenshot is needed to measure font sizes for Rule 31.
listing_font_parity: Net quantity vs MRP font size
listing_empty: Enter a listing URL or upload a screenshot.
verify_not_found: No report found for this hash.
utility_strip_title: NIRIKSHAN · Legal Metrology Compliance & Inspection System
search_placeholder: Search by rule, commodity or scan...
footer_legal_text: Nirikshan is a decision-support prototype developed for SIH26034, not an official Government of India enforcement portal. In all inspection matters, the determination of the authorised Legal Metrology Officer prevails.
mod_drishti_desc: RapidOCR on CPU via ONNX Runtime, EXIF and perspective handling, bbox-adjacency key-value extraction, multi-panel 360° merge with panel provenance.
mod_niyam_desc: The catalogue in YAML with rule citations, effective dates and a versioned content hash; an applicability resolver that marks exempt packages N/A instead of failing them.
mod_maap_desc: Clear space around the net quantity, letter width-to-height ratio and luminance contrast, estimated from OCR boxes and always returned for officer confirmation, never as a hard failure.
mod_tol_desc: First Schedule maximum permissible error on a weighed package, and the Rule 19 lot procedure with tare determination, corrected average and a Seventh Schedule Form A/B data sheet.
mod_jaal_desc: Listing text and screenshots checked for the Rule 6(10) declarations and Rule 31 font parity between MRP and net quantity.
mod_pramaan_desc: Evidence overlay, inspection report PDF with the image SHA-256 and a verification QR, and an append-only hash-chained audit ledger.
verdict_desc_INFO: For information only, no action needed
verdict_desc_MANUAL: You must confirm this by hand
verdict_desc_NA: This rule does not apply to this package
step03_desc: Applicability: which rules apply to this package
step04_desc: Deterministic verdicts with five reasons behind each
step06_desc: Report PDF, audit ledger, QR verification
field_cpu_desc: No GPU required, runs on standard desktop/server
field_bilingual_desc: Full English & Hindi support across interface & PDF
field_deterministic_desc: No LLM hallucinations in any compliance verdict
landing_statutory_note: Nirikshan is a decision-support prototype for SIH26034. AI is used for reading text only; every compliance verdict is deterministic and the authorised officer's determination prevails.
try_sample_sub: Load bundled label images into the capture panel to run instant compliance scans
try_sample_four_violations_desc: 4 LMPC violations: missing manufacturer details, PIN, MRP & USP
try_sample_compliant_desc: Fully compliant label with all required declarations present
try_sample_sachet_desc: Exempt under Rule 26(a) for small packages under 10g/10ml
what_gets_checked_note: 39 rules active in catalogue. Package-specific exemptions (e.g. Rule 26 small sachets, wholesale, FSSAI) are evaluated dynamically at scan time.
app_rules_fetch_failed: Rule engine catalogue temporarily unavailable. Rules will be evaluated at scan time.
review_pairing_step1_desc: Scan the QR code on your mobile camera or enter the session code
review_pairing_step2_desc: Capture 360° label photos and tap Run Compliance Scan
review_pairing_step3_desc: Findings and evidence overlays stream live to this desktop console
review_fetch_failed: Session connection standby. Scans will appear as soon as a mobile device pairs or image is uploaded.
listing_scope_desc: Rule 6(10) mandates that e-commerce listings display all mandatory PDP declarations before sale. Rule 31 requires that Net Quantity font size is at least equal to MRP font size.
listing_font_note: Note: Web URL scraping checks textual declaration presence. A listing screenshot is required to measure pixel dimensions for Rule 31 font parity comparison.
listing_error_reason: Listing verification standby. Enter a valid marketplace URL or upload listing screenshots above.
